name: Blaze of Destiny II -The Beginning of the Fate-
source:
A sacred land where many mysteries sleep out of reach of major kingdoms... 
Leon is exiled by his brother and declared a criminal. He is chased by armed men, and he only gets saved thanks to Leiria girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这里是一片远离各大王国、沉睡着无数谜团的圣地…
莱昂遭兄长流放，还被宣布为罪犯。面对武装人员追捕，他幸得一名雷利亚少女相救，才保住性命。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
